Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks for the clear list — answers below and attached the more detailed matrix.

1) Telemetry / observability subprocessors:
- Segment (Twilio Segment): used for ingestion/routing of analytics events. By default we do not send full message payloads to Segment; we recommend event-level telemetry and have config flags to strip PII at ingestion.
- Datadog: used for observability/metrics/traces. Datadog receives sampled traces and aggregated metrics; we do not forward full request payloads by default.
- Sentry: used for error reporting; sensitive fields can be scrubbed before events are sent.
(See attached subprocessors-detailed-matrix-2026-02-22.xlsx for versioned vendor contracts and subprocessors addendum links.)

2) Cloud provider & regions:
- Redwood runs primary hosted customers on AWS. We offer region pinning for Production fleets; yes — we can pin your tenant to us-east-1. For enterprise customers we also offer Private deployment (VPC) where all networking and storage remain in your cloud account.

3) Marketplace flows / third-party access:
- Marketplace listings (e.g., cloud marketplace) are for provisioning and billing only. We do not transfer application payloads to marketplace partners. Any third-party integrations that require data transfer are explicitly listed in the subprocessor matrix and require customer sign-off.

4) Logs, PII, and retention:
- Default: request/ingest logs retained for 30 days (configurable).
- We support contract-level retention options: 90, 365, or customer-requested custom windows (we’ll include in the SOW).
- PII handling: Redwood provides field-level redaction at ingestion and post-ingest scrubbing. We also support customer-managed KMS for encrypting persisted artifacts and KV cache.
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II report attached; we can provide a short implementation note for your InfoSec team and a sample redaction config.

Next steps I suggest:
- Marissa: schedule the 30-min tech sync for Mon 2/22 09:00 PST (I’m available).
- Acme: confirm whether 90-day retention is sufficient or if you need the 365-day option.
- Procurement: once retention is agreed we’ll send the DPA + subprocessor addendum (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign / DPA: https://www.docusign.com/link/to/dpa-acme
Subprocessor matrix (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-subprocessors-docs

Happy to provide any additional artifacts your team needs (redaction config, sample logs with redacted fields, or runtime architecture diagram).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
